prompt_summary: The exact existing straight-on landscape composition restyled as a Cloverhollow watercolor prop: blank lilac header, wide symmetric mint glass interior, one-point floor and ceiling, front-left prize chute, teal control ledge, left joystick and right button. Empty box, no claw, rail, plushes, or text.
key_colour: paper margin sampled from border; removed by border-connected flood fill
post_processing: Used two Gemini image-editing passes with the previous straight-on machine as the exact composition reference and the arcade room/concept as style references; selected the second pass because its measured floor and ceiling edges preserve the corrected common vanishing point.
The selected 2400x1792 output is retained in art/source/arcade/claw-machine-front-raw.png.

tools/art/build-claw-machine.ts flood-fills the border paper with 8% fuzz, trims the transparent margin, despills only antialiased pixels within three pixels of the alpha edge, resizes to 1600px wide, and encodes WebP quality 90 with alpha.
No opaque fill is used in the calibration overlay; its floor grid uses s = 941/1377 and t = u / (s + (1-s)u).

owner_review.note: The restyled machine reads as watercolor with soft pigment variation, paper texture, and warm-brown hand ink. The style comparison shows it belongs with the arcade painting and plush line, though the plush outlines remain slightly stronger than the machine's delicate contours.
